reason: Nobody in my family or village has one of these battery washers yet, and I am not going to be the first to spend twenty-two thousand on something new. Also my inverter can already run a semi-automatic, so I would rather buy a bigger inverter battery that runs the fan and lights too.
objection: A lithium battery inside a washing machine that sits in water and heat, in a village where service means waiting for the dealer to send someone. If the battery dies after three years, how much will a new one cost me, and will this brand even be around?
would_change_my_mind: If my cousin or a neighbour used it for a few months through the summer power cuts and said it works, and the dealer I already trust told me the replacement battery price up front.
